sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Front-facing serious clean-shaven man with short black wavy side-parted hair and thick separate dark eyebrows; rust-brown narrow striped broad-lapel jacket, muted olive-grey pointed-collar shirt, dark navy tie, and small blue circular red-and-white triangular badge on screen-left lapel. Tight bust crop against mottled pale blue-grey painted backing, light from screen-left.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Front-facing serious clean-shaven man with dark brown smooth high side-parted hair swept toward screen-right and separate dark eyebrows; brown broad rounded coat lapels over light grey pointed-collar shirt and dark tie with small muted red dots. Tight bust on mottled blue-grey backing with light from screen-left.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Front-facing serious clean-shaven man with short curled brown side-parted hair, separate dark eyebrows, large round dark-rim spectacles, and white laboratory coat over grey pointed-collar buttoned shirt; rectangular clipped identity card at lower screen-right coat edge with illegibly tiny text. Tight bust on mottled blue-grey backing, light screen-left.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Front-facing serious man with a thin separate dark moustache, dark eyebrows and short dark hair largely beneath a tan straw fedora with wide pale satin band; blue-grey coat over pale blue open pointed-collar button shirt, burgundy hardback book with double pale cover-border lines held upright at lower screen-right. Tight bust on mottled blue-grey backing, light screen-left.
